title: Rooms Records Prune — payload
description: A holder of `admin` asks a room's host to remove the records the room's record retention makes eligible — retracted tombstones, records older than it allows, or both — leaving a mark that records were removed and never what they said.

roomId.description: The room whose records to prune. A host verifies the presentation against credentials issued by this identifier, never against a member list of its own.

presentation.description: Must confer `admin` at this room's scope. Not `curate`: every member who can write can be given curate, and curation is a statement about one record that leaves a tombstone behind, where a prune removes records — tombstones included — for every member, permanently.

kinds.description: What to remove. `retracted`: tombstones older than the record retention's `tombstoneDays`. `aged`: records of any standing, pinned ones excepted, older than its `recordDays`. A set; order carries no meaning. A kind the retention in force states no rule for removes nothing, and a request all of whose kinds are such is refused with `noRetention`.

reason.description: Why, for the room's audit trail. REQUIRED: a prune is irreversible and leaves nothing of what it removed, so the reason recorded at the time is the only account of intent there will ever be. Plain text; it MUST NOT name a member or quote a record.

dryRun.description: `true` asks what a prune would remove now, and removes nothing: no version is taken, no mark is left, no blob is released. Absent means `false`. A surface offering a prune SHOULD show this first — what is about to become unreadable — before asking for the real one.

ext.description: Ecosystem-defined extension members per SPEC.md §4.5.1. A host MUST NOT treat a member here as widening what is removed.

dryRun.description: Present, and `true`, only when nothing was removed because the request asked for a dry run. Absent on a real prune: one spelling per meaning.

removed.description: How many records were removed — or, on a dry run, would be — tombstones included. `0` is a success: nothing was eligible, and a caller that read it as a failure would retry an operation with nothing to do.

blobsReleased.description: How many stored blobs the removed records named and no remaining record names — released exactly as a rewrite or retraction releases them (`rooms/records/put` 0.2, consumer item 8). On a dry run, how many would be. Absent means none.

recordRetention.description: The record retention the prune was made under, as in force when the host performed it — which is what decided eligibility, and what a caller holding an earlier listing checks the removal against.

prune.description: The mark the prune left, now the room's `lastPrune`. Present when at least one record was removed and the request was not a dry run; absent otherwise.
